prime.title: moai — this session
prime.held_none: Nothing picked up. `moai ready` shows what to take
prime.ready_none: Nothing ready. `moai show` shows what is waiting
prime.milestone: A milestone is running — what is inside it comes first ({ids}). A p0 outside it still gets picked
prime.close_pick: Pick one up before touching the repo — `moai mv <id> in_progress --from todo`
prime.close_scope: Found something outside what you hold? Ask first — can this epic deliver what it promised without it? If not it is a member: same epic (`-e`) or a child (`--parent`). Only otherwise `moai idea add`. Leaving it unwritten is the worst
prime.close_review: A review is an issue too — raise one before `/code-review`. `-b` says what you are looking at and `-m` closes it; without either the write is refused
prime.close_model: Leave the AI that did the work — `moai note <id> 'model: <vendor>/<model> tokens=<n> (<grade> — <why>)'`
prime.close_handoff: Closing while still holding it? Leave the next session a line — `moai note <id> 'next: …'`
prime.close_status: Run `moai status` once more and see the warnings did not grow
prime.cmd_ready: what you can pick up now
prime.cmd_show: body, children, history — why it was decided that way
prime.cmd_mv: pick it up (only while the column still stands)
prime.cmd_note: a note the next session reads
prime.cmd_idea: park what is not for now
